name: Jiming Canhun: Xiari Qiyuan
source:
The protagonist of this story is a ogre, living a nightmare like life alone. Until one day, when he was about to be killed, a mysterious girl appeared and saved him. With her help, gained even stronger power. But he didn't know that this power could plunge him into the abyss of destruction.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3946010]Steam[/url]]
